title: A worn design system maps every template colour by its role, and the preview rules judge what a visitor sees
steps: S1: Run the tracy-ds-slot tests for the auto palette (classification, emitted rules, presets never repointed, contract bands left alone, Joomla slot size).
S2: Run the measurement test for the four preview rules TPL-1, CON-2, BTN-1, PREV-1.
S3: Run the preview door and asset door tests (error page after </html> cut, fonts through the asset door, scroll-revealed content shown).
expect: S1: every auto palette test passes; every Joomla slot with a palette is under 60 KB under Moxie.
S2: the rules are unmeasurable without a preview block and fail per system and scheme with one.
evidence: 14/10/2026: under Moxie the Add site preview of JA Resort showed a khaki band with black text and JA Impact kept its orange and navy blocks while every built-site rule passed
fence: packages/design/tracy-ds-slot: auto-palette.mjs, library.mjs paletteOf, joomla.mjs and wordpress.mjs (auto palette, ink band roleValues, color-scheme), measurement.mjs judgePreview; apps/tracy-web: design-system-preview-page.js (previewDocOf cut, REVEALED), design-system-preview-assets.js, design-system-preview-probe.js, scripts/preview-check.mjs, readiness rules TPL-1 CON-2 BTN-1 PREV-1.
